name: Free Ohio state ID card
description: A state ID card at no charge, for Ohio residents 17 and older who do not have a valid driver license.
eligibility: Ohio residents 17 or older without a valid driver license. Under 18 needs a parent or guardian along.

steps: Gather proof of your full legal name, date of birth, Social Security number, legal presence and Ohio address.
Save your spot in line online. Then go to any BMV license office.
